results.title: Gargantuan
results.overview: Five washed-up heroes reunite to pilot their giant robot and save the world.

results.title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
results.overview: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.

results.title: Por el sabor de ese Kebab
results.original_title: Por el sabor de ese Kebab

results.title: Kebab, Wine, Bill!
results.overview: The restaurant opens for just one table — but that table tests everyone’s patience.  Staff in love, uncontrollable managers, a worn-out waitress, and a chef who couldn’t care less about the world — today, they all had to break free from someone’s control.  There is only one question: at the end of this “special service,” who will pay the bill?

results.title: Lorie Party 2026 au cinéma
results.overview: Lorie invites you to a colorful and festive evening! Hear all her greatest hits during her Lorie Party 2025/2026 tour!

results.title: Nichts wie weg
results.overview: Nurse Anke Bender reacts decisively to inappropriate behavior. After a patient gropes her, she slaps him. Unfortunately, the patient turns out to be none other than Hamburg’s health senator, who dies the very next day following an incorrectly administered IV. To avoid arrest, Anke impulsively flees in an ambulance—unaware that the injured pianist Luise Dobertin is inside.

results.title: Dance
results.overview: After Milica receives the final results of her pregnancy test, she must face her life's mistakes.

results.title: Cassandre - Ni vu, ni connu
results.overview: The discovery of a man’s body in the shower cabin of local baths plunges the establishment into astonishment. Without identity papers and unknown to the registers, the victim can only be identified through his fingerprints.

results.title: Quem Tem com Que Me Pague, Não Me Deve Nada
results.original_title: Quem Tem com Que Me Pague, Não Me Deve Nada
results.overview: Henrique, a struggling São Paulo filmmaker, is invited to direct a music video for Bahian singer Cristian Mugunzá, beloved by legions of fans. With music, humor, and drama, their relationship becomes a turning point for both.

results.title: Glaxo
results.overview: Chivilcoy, 1957. In a quiet Argentinian town, the arrival of an ominous former police commissioner and his seductive wife fractures the bond between four inseparable young men. Decades later, the past resurfaces, forcing them to confront old wounds, guilt, and the possibility of revenge in a country which has lost its innocence.

results.title: Une chimère
results.overview: Rachel suddenly learns that she has blood cancer and that only a bone marrow transplant can save her. She will then have to let another DNA enter into her to become, what we call in genetics, a chimera. Strange dreams then begin to assail Rachel.

results.title: Midnight Incense
results.original_title: ธูป เที่ยงคืน วิญญาณ
results.overview: A company promises free accommodation. But nothing in this world comes without a price. Because this house collects its rent - in souls.

results.title: Merz gegen Merz - Entscheidungen
results.overview: When their mother suddenly starts planning her engagement to a woman, Anne and Erik Merz find themselves caught up in a whirlwind of cheese buffets, chocolate fountains, and old feelings.

results.title: Hay Nako!
results.overview: When Jordan arrives to the wedding of her best friend (Charlotte), the consequences of a recent interaction they shared come into fruition - all with the background of Charlotte's chaotic Filipino family.

results.title: The Theft
results.overview: The Theft traces a set of ancient, treasured artifacts stolen from Afghanistan that have, in some cases, ended up in the hands of Western museums.

results.title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
results.original_title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
results.overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.

results.title: Madame in Saigon
results.overview: Mesdames Thanh Sắc follows the intertwined lives of the captivating beauty Cầm Thanh (Thanh Hằng) and Madame Sắc (Hồng Ánh), the wealthy owner of the prestigious Kim Đô nightclub, renowned for her fortune and vast collection of diamonds. Though she rises through Madame Sắc’s ranks to become one of Saigon’s most celebrated dancers in the 1960s, Cầm Thanh longs to break free from her patron’s control. As their ambitions and desires collide, the two women become locked in a tense power struggle that sets off a series of shocking and far-reaching events.

results.title: Do You Understand Or Do I Have To Spell It Out For You?
results.overview: Madrid, Spring 1992. Pepe, owner of a Catalan tavern in Chueca, faces the worst streak of his life: his bar is in ruin, his wife leaves him and the debts drown him. When he thinks all is lost, his friends propose a twist as unexpected as brilliant: turn the tavern into a gay pub! What happens from there is an unstoppable succession of entanglements, crazy situations and endearing characters, in a politically incorrect comedy, current, and absolutely smarty.
